meta_description:
12 likes, 0 comments - bosseventsbe on September 16, 2026: "🏏👑 THE ROYALS ARE READY TO RULE THE FIELD! 👑🏏

The Boss Royals XI are stepping onto the pitch at the AEEMF Entertainment Cup 2026 — and we’re here to bring the energy, the passion, the camaraderie and, of course, a little Royal swagger! 🔥

This isn’t just about runs, wickets and boundaries.
It’s about friendship, fraternity, sportsmanship and the spirit of the game. ❤️🏏

So, Kolkata… make some noise! 📣
Root for Boss Royals XI. Cheer for every run. Celebrate every wicket. Back every player.
Because when the fraternity comes together, every match becomes a celebration!

👑 BOSS ROYALS XI
Create. Conquer. Celebrate. 🏆

A huge shoutout to AEEMF – Association of Event Managers Fraternity Entertainment for bringing our industry together beyond the boardrooms and event floors. 🙌

🎤 Presented by: eVentures
🤝 Supported by: Green Entertainment
🏏 AEEMF Entertainment Cup 2026

📍 Orchid Arena, Kolkata
📅 29th, 30th September & 1st October 2026

Cheers to AEEMF! 🥂
Cheers to the fraternity! ❤️
And cheers to the beautiful spirit of the game! 🏏👑

#BossRoyalsXI #AEEMFEntertainmentCup2026 #AEEMF #EventManagersFraternity #bosseventsbe".
